Game Overview

In Platform Swap, the core idea is straightforward: control a high-tech robot with the power to shift colors in Platform Swap. Navigate intricate platforms by perfectly timing your strategic color swaps. Reflexes are your best ally in this fast-paced, challenging adventure where the right hue keeps you standing and the wrong one sends you plunging.
